jobs.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for existing side scrolling game. Reference is the exact existing Hexy character and drawing style, NOT a sheet to duplicate. Create 12 NEW expressive full body poses, arranged in exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, evenly spaced cells, all facing RIGHT, no labels or frame borders. Same long pink hair, navy witch hat with gold star, white sailor blouse red bow, navy skirt, navy knee socks and chunky dark boots, star wand retained in one hand. Preserve face, body proportions and outfit exactly. Row 1 WATER HIT four successive poses: flinch shielding face with forearm and closed eyes; leaning away soaked hair and droplets; wiping face while steadying hat; recovering stance with a few falling droplets. Row 2 FIRE HIT four poses: recoil from heat in front, arm shielding eyes; crouched shoulders hat blown back and tiny orange embers; shake off heat with small wisps of smoke; settle back to ready. No burns or clothing damage. Row 3 SOUND PRESSURE HIT four poses: eyes shut shoulders up; one hand pressed over ear while other grips wand, hat and hair swept backward; stagger with bent knees and dizzy grimace; recovering balance. Each row is animation of same character, not redesign. Clear silhouettes at small display size, polished hand painted storybook game art with dark ink outlines, not vector. Very little VFX obscuring body. All sprites same anatomical scale, feet on same row baseline. Every entire hat/hair/wand/boots within its cell, wide transparent gutters, real alpha transparency everywhere between sprites. No ground, text, scenery, shadows on background or checkerboard. Output 1536x1152 or matching 4:3 atlas.
